integrity: The claim uses exact oriented adjacent-pair multiplicities and labeled symbols; two finite checkers and a complete mathematical argument are included. An unindexed equivalent prior structural result cannot be ruled out.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies global singleton fibers of nonnesting double-occurrence sources only, not all unrestricted doubled words, not entire non-singleton fiber distributions, and not higher-order or circular spectra. Finite verification is supplementary to the all-length proof. The numerical sequence n! 2^(n-1) is known as OEIS A002866; only its reconstructibility characterization is asserted as new.
title: Global two-gram singleton boundary for nonnesting double-occurrence words
